name: parameterised query replaced by string concatenation
about: A parameterised query is replaced with string concatenation.
diff:
diff --git a/users.py b/users.py
--- a/users.py
+++ b/users.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def find_user(cur, raw_id):
-    cur.execute("select * from users where id = %s", (raw_id,))
+    cur.execute("select * from users where id = " + raw_id)
     return cur.fetchone()

findings.title: SQL injection: raw_id is concatenated into the query
findings.quoted_code: cur.execute("select * from users where id = " + raw_id)

skeptic.reason: user input reaches the query unescaped
